posts.title: Debian MountainCamp, Innsbruck, 16–18 May 2025
posts.description: the days are getting warmer (in the northern hemisphere), debian is getting colder , & quite a few debian events are taking place. in innsbruck, we are organizing MountainCamp, an event in the tradition of SunCamp & SnowCamp: no schedule, no talks, meet other debian people, fix bugs, come up with crazy ideas, have fun, develop things. location: it-syndikat hackspace ( tschamlerstraße 3, innsbruck,
